preserved_evidence_maps.policy: The current v1 title, abstract, contribution, research-question, figure, table, discussion, conclusion, negative-result, null-result, onset-inapplicable, proxy, single-sequence, and non-operational maps remain the pre-v2 evidence record. They are not prospective v2 outcomes.
preserved_evidence_maps.legacy_results_rule: All numerical statements currently in the preserved maps remain scoped to p1_s3_fair_v1 until a later results-narrative stage validates and explicitly replaces them from v2 artifacts.
preserved_evidence_maps.human_metadata_rule: Do not add, remove, resolve, or infer any author, affiliation, corresponding-author, funding, CRediT, conflict, ORCID, biography, photograph, or disclosure metadata in this stage.

scope.task: RTS-GMLC delivery-row retrospective lag prediction of a fixed curtailment-risk proxy

target.proxy_rate: y_t = max(0, r_t - u_t) / max(1, r_t)

features.normalization: per-feature mean and population standard deviation from source feature rows 0:4380 only; standard deviations below 1e-9 are replaced by 1
features.stress_feature_boundary: engineered from static branch aggregates and delivery-row dynamics; not a power-flow, contingency, or feasibility calculation

experimental_grid.cross_cap_interpretation: descriptive only on the same fixed sequence; no cross-cap p-values, pooling, model selection, or generalization claim
experimental_grid.seed_interpretation: common algorithmic initialization and minibatch-order seeds; not randomized experimental assignments

temporal_protocol.indexing: zero-based delivery-row indices with half-open intervals

rules.window_history: all 48 rows end at s; earlier-phase history inside a downstream-phase window is permitted

DLinear.padding: endpoint replication, 12 rows on each side
DLinear.decomposition: trend is centered moving average; seasonal is input minus trend
DLinear.temporal_maps: two shared Linear(48, 1) maps, one for trend and one for seasonal, applied featurewise
DLinear.head: sum trend and seasonal feature forecasts, then Linear(7, 1)

TCN.causality: left padding only; trim to 48 time steps
TCN.head: Linear(48, 1) from final time step

architectures.comparison_boundary: Architectures are not parameter-count matched. Any architecture-superiority statement must name one prespecified paired contrast, horizon, metric, cap, and multiplicity-adjusted family.

common_training_budget.initialization: PyTorch default module initialization after setting the common seed
common_training_budget.minibatch_order: one torch.randperm per epoch from a CPU torch.Generator initialized with the common seed
common_training_budget.no_extra_budget: No architecture receives additional epochs, checkpoints, seeds, restarts, early-stopping patience, or result-triggered tuning.

selection_and_scoring.checkpoint_selection: separately for each architecture, cap, horizon, objective, and seed, select the direct-head checkpoint on selection rows
selection_and_scoring.head_first_rule: For learned GRU retrieval, select the GRU direct-head checkpoint first; freeze it for learned embeddings, blend selection, and all learned-space matched controls.
selection_and_scoring.selection_predictions: unclipped direct or blended predictions, matching the frozen v1 executable order

tie_breaks.detection_threshold: lowest unique threshold in ascending order

selection_and_scoring.test_visibility: No test metric, per-target test loss, bootstrap summary, plot, or ranking may affect checkpoint, alpha, k, penalty, threshold, architecture, seed, retry, or claim-family selection.

Ridge.penalty_selection: selection rows separately for MAE and onset-F1 objectives
Ridge.inference_role: descriptive deterministic reference; no seed-based p-value

Persistence.prediction: y_(t-h), the proxy at the query endpoint

Seasonal-24h.horizon_24_note: identical to Persistence at h=24 and retained as an explicit identity check

DirectPolicyTransform-Privileged.prediction: apply the proxy equation to target-hour load, wind, and PV
DirectPolicyTransform-Privileged.boundary: not a lag forecast and not operational evidence

retrieval.neighbor_weighting: unweighted mean of fit-bank target values
retrieval.k_selection: k is never selected from test results; k=8 is primary and k=4/16/32 are descriptive sensitivity conditions

learned.name: forecasting-trained GRU embedding
learned.construction: dimension-48 last-time-step embedding from the head-selected GRU checkpoint

raw.name: raw-feature kNN attribution control
raw.construction: flatten the fit-only standardized 48-by-7 input window to dimension 336

randomized.name: randomized-encoder retrieval attribution control
randomized.construction: dimension-48 last-time-step output of an untrained one-layer GRU initialized with the same common seed and PyTorch defaults

retrieval.learned_space_attribution_gate: The phrase learned-space advantage or an equivalent attribution claim is licensed only for the prespecified learned-versus-raw and learned-versus-randomized k=8 paired contrasts when both controls have complete valid rows. A learned-versus-head contrast alone is insufficient.
retrieval.alternative_distance_scope: No alternative distance is evaluated; no distance-superiority claim is licensed.

onset_protocol.selection_objective: maximize onset F1 on selection rows using an objective-local threshold grid
onset_protocol.onset_inapplicable_rule: If selection or calibration has zero positive onsets, retain complete audit rows and diagnostic test metrics but mark onset_targeted_claim_valid=false. This is scientific inapplicability, not execution failure and not proof of no effect.
onset_protocol.known_pre_v2_boundary: The preserved v1 evidence reports zero selection and calibration onsets for every cap and horizon. The v2 contract must not erase or relabel that boundary.

metrics.primary: test mean absolute error of the continuous proxy
metrics.event_threshold: max(0.02, median of positive fit targets) when at least 20 positive fit targets exist; otherwise 0.02

analysis_units.moving_block_supplement: chronological test-target loss-difference series averaged across the ten paired seeds

row_contract.completeness_rule: Emit exactly one row for every expected key, including failed conditions. Do not drop, replace, or silently impute a failed row.

failure_handling.completed_row_requirements: all required metrics finite except a metric whose denominator/support is explicitly absent and accompanied by a named scientific_support_status
failure_handling.failed_row_requirements: retain the expected key, set scientific metrics to null, record a controlled failure_code and sanitized exception class, and propagate the failure to every dependent row
failure_handling.protocol_complete_gate: all 2310 expected rows exist and every row required by a declared evidence table or statistical contrast has execution_status=completed
failure_handling.effect_direction_separation: A completed valid row may be favorable, null, mixed, or adverse. Effect direction never changes execution_status and never by itself changes protocol validity.
failure_handling.onset_separation: fallback_no_positive_onsets and onset_targeted_claim_valid=false are scientific-support states, not execution failures.

effect_sizes.difference: treatment metric minus control metric within each common seed
reported: sample standard deviation of paired differences
effect_sizes.dz: mean(d) / sample_sd(d); report null with zero_variance flag when sample_sd(d)=0

exact_sign_flip.enumeration: all 2^10 sign assignments, retaining zero differences
exact_sign_flip.assumption: paired differences are sign-exchangeable across the frozen algorithmic seeds under the no-effect null

seed_conditional_interval.label: 95% seed-conditional t interval for the mean paired difference
seed_conditional_interval.scope: training-seed variability conditional on the ten frozen seeds, sequence, cap, horizon, protocol, and contrast; not uncertainty over hours, blocks, years, systems, policies, vintages, operators, or deployments
seed_conditional_interval.zero_variance: report the point interval [mean(d), mean(d)] with a zero_variance flag

holm.ordering: ascending unadjusted exact p-value, tie-broken by frozen contrast order
holm.formula: adjusted ordered p_i = cumulative max through i of min(1, (m-i+1)*p_i)
holm.family_partition: separately for each family_id and horizon at cap 0.70; never pool horizons, families, objectives, or caps

families.interpretation: primary paired mechanism and learned-space attribution family
contrast-specific direct-head architecture comparisons; no omnibus winner and no benchmark gate
diagnostic family only when pre-test onset support is absent; exact tests do not cure inapplicability

descriptive_only: all comparisons with Persistence, Seasonal-24h, Ridge, or DirectPolicyTransform-Privileged
all onset-family readouts when selection or calibration onset support is absent

supplementary_moving_block_analysis.loss_series: For target t and paired seed s, d_(s,t)=abs(y_t-clipped_prediction_treatment_(s,t))-abs(y_t-clipped_prediction_control_(s,t)); the chronological series resampled is d_t=mean over the ten common seeds of d_(s,t).

bootstrap.type: ordinary overlapping moving-block bootstrap without circular wrap
bootstrap.construction: form all n-L+1 overlapping consecutive blocks; sample ceil(n/L) block starts with replacement; concatenate in sampled order; truncate to n; record the resampled mean
bootstrap.point_estimate: arithmetic mean of the unresampled d_t series

supplementary_moving_block_analysis.interpretation: Report both block lengths as a dependence-aware descriptive sensitivity on the single observed test sequence. Do not call the intervals confidence intervals over years or systems, do not use them for Holm decisions, and do not let them override the seed-paired primary analysis.
supplementary_moving_block_analysis.incomplete_rule: If any required per-target prediction or any of the ten paired seeds is absent, mark the affected moving-block cell incomplete; do not impute or shorten the contrast list.

requires: source hashes and sequence identity match
all frozen candidates and seeds are attempted
all evidence-bearing rows complete without leakage or substitution
paired, interval, Holm, and moving-block outputs follow this contract
manifest hashes every executable, input identity record, and output

validity_and_interpretation.effect_direction: favorable, null, mixed, and adverse are scientific outcomes and must be reported without changing the protocol-validity decision
validity_and_interpretation.bounded_benchmark_contribution: A complete valid null, mixed, or adverse result still supports the bounded contribution of an auditable single-sequence retrospective benchmark and its failure-aware comparison protocol. It does not support a favorable method claim.
validity_and_interpretation.negative_and_null_preservation: All nulls, adverse comparisons, ties, onset inapplicability, naive-baseline wins, and descriptive cap crossings must appear in result, discussion, and conclusion maps with their scope qualifiers.
scope_boundaries: retrospective delivery-row lags rather than operational forecasts
one truncated 8760-row sequence rather than a complete year
one RTS-GMLC system rather than cross-system evidence
training-seed uncertainty rather than hour/year/system uncertainty
no OPF/UC, operator, deployment, safety, or economic validation
combined ablations support joint conclusions only
proxy and historical studies retain their scope qualifiers

benchmark_contribution.claim: auditable retrospective benchmark with a prospectively frozen, failure-aware comparison protocol

learned_space_attribution.gate: both controls and both prespecified k=8 paired contrasts are complete and valid; wording follows the observed directions and adjusted family

architecture_superiority.gate: name the exact architecture-head contrast, cap 0.70, horizon, MAE metric, seed-conditional scope, effect direction, and within-family Holm result

onset_benefit.gate: positive onset support in both selection and calibration plus complete valid objective-matched rows

requires: Stage-4 verified literature positioning of the auditable benchmark
ieee_access_clear_advance.failed_literature_positioning_rule: If Stage-4 literature positioning is not verified, clear-advance remains unverified even when the experiment is complete.
ieee_access_clear_advance.failed_effect_rule: A valid null or adverse method result narrows the method claim but is not a protocol failure and does not erase the bounded benchmark contribution.

future_artifact_contract.contract_stage_absence_rule: No later execution file or results directory may be created during p1v4_s1_upgrade_contract.
